An experimental, fully on-device iPhone app for backing up selected photos, videos, and albums to Google Photos. It is a single SwiftUI app that completes Google account setup in an in-app web view, so everything happens on the phone without a desktop companion or hosted service.

Changelogs:
Photos Backup Update

New Features:
- Background Backups: Plays silent audio to prevent app suspension during backups; Location mode available as fallback.
- Background Persistence Fix: Built with Xcode 26.3 to properly restore background backups & Live Activity on iOS 26.
- Full Media Backup: Backs up original edited/Cinematic videos and auto-enables Live Photo motion backups by default.

Fixes & Performance:
- Stopped Duplicate Uploads: Fixed bug where system metadata updates (favorites, iOS analysis) triggered re-uploads.
- CPU & Disk Optimization: Parallel file hashing and throttled queue saves prevent system-forced app crashes.
- Faster UI: Optimized Activity tab rendering for large backup queues.
- Display Handling: Screen can now lock normally when background backup is active.

Important Tips:
- Swiping away the app from the app switcher stops background backups.
- Overnight charging is recommended for large backups due to battery usage.
